description: Bro- och tunneldata - väg is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. The data product consists of phenomena of the type Bridge and Tunnel included in the National Road Database (NVDB) and includes data on crossings, underpasses and tunnels on road sections. Data are available, for example, at bridges, level crossings, road gates and tunnels. Coverage: Sweden. The portal shows the English title as "Bridge and tunnel data - road" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include NVDB. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
